releaseNotes: GassNative 0.3: audio and desktop improvements, welcome news, and update-checking improvements. Experimental release.

news.title: Welcome to GassNative!
news.message: Welcome to Gass-OS! Explore your Debian Linux desktop, discover the available tools, and follow the project as it evolves. GassNative is experimental software; keep backups of important files. Thank you for trying GassNative.
